description.translate: Eight gold ingots will restore the fine comparison contacts. Their use here is practical. I have no interest in gilding a ruin so that it resembles success. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The ring held three discoveries: the dragon's flight, the Snow Queen's barrier and the Hydra's regenerative strength. Edda made a protective ward usable through engraving. Flight and the greater recovery needed awakening and a personal bond. Capturing power had not finished that work.
